name: ops — weekly digest of open applications in Slack

nodes.name: Every Friday morning
nodes.notes: DIGEST_CRON, Fridays at 09:00 by default. The workflow pins Europe/Berlin, so the hour is Berlin time whatever the server clock says.

nodes.name: Look up the Slack workspace
nodes.notes: auth.test returns the workspace address, which a thread link needs and the row does not hold. On a failure the digest still posts, with names instead of links.

nodes.name: Get open rows
nodes.notes: Every row not yet approved, rejected or resigned. Always outputs, so a week with nothing open still reaches the render step and posts.
